uploadListingImage: If image and listing_image_id both supplied, binary image wins upstream; planned MCP should reject ambiguity. Asynchronous colors/size can be null; read metadata later.
deleteListingImage: Association removed, underlying Etsy copy retained and reassociable; not binary erasure.
uploadListingVideo: Existing video must belong to same shop. Description says is_multi_video=true permits up to two videos, but no query/body property declares this flag: wire placement unresolved, block that extension pending clarification.
deleteListingVideo: Association removed; retained video can be reassociated; not binary erasure.
createDraftListing: Draft creation is not publication. Conditional physical shipping/readiness and later image/file activation prerequisites apply. Stop sending deprecated legacy personalization fields.

getPayments: payment_ids required despite optional-sounding description/tutorial. Money-shaped fields retain own divisor/currency, not blanket pennies.
getPaymentAccountLedgerEntryPayments: Use required ledger_entry_ids, not tutorial's ledger_id wording. Unrelated entries can have no payment.

getShopPaymentAccountLedgerEntry: Standalone amount/balance integers have no specified divisor. No invented cents conversion. Adjustment currencies/units are field-specific; see README.

updateShopShippingProfile: Country/region mutually exclusive; carrier+mail_class or min+max delivery days required. Shared impact; processing is not transit.
createShopShippingProfileDestination: Shop currency; country/region mutually exclusive; neither defaults to everywhere. Carrier+mail_class or delivery range required.

deleteShopShippingProfileUpgrade: Removes upgrade from all listings using profile.

getShopReadinessStateDefinitions: Paged shops_r processing definitions. No legacy query declared on this operation; do not blanket-copy migration examples.
